text: Ever. Have you ever seen snow?
Never. I have never been to Japan.
Twice. I have been on that ride twice.
So far. So far, I have read three chapters.
Bucket list. Seeing snow is on my bucket list.
Brave. She was brave and jumped first.
Scary. That film was really scary.
Unforgettable. My first concert was unforgettable.
Have you ever been to a concert?
Okay, question. Have you ever been on a really big roller coaster?
Twice? When was the first time?
Last year, at the park. I kept my eyes closed from start to finish.
Very. But it was unforgettable. Have you ever tried it?
No, never. It’s on my bucket list, but I’m not that brave.
Come on. So far, what’s the scariest thing you’ve done?
I’ve sung in front of the whole school. Once.
That’s much scarier than a roller coaster. We’re going on Saturday.

So, my teacher asked us to write a bucket list, and I thought, okay, easy. Then I started, and I realized I have never done most of the things I want to do. I have never seen snow. Not once, in my whole life. I have been to the beach about a hundred times, so that one does not count. I have never tried sushi, and my friends say that is a crime. And the scary one: I have never been on a really big roller coaster. I went on a small one twice, when I was nine, and I screamed the whole time. So, number one on the list? The big one. I want to be brave about it. Ask me again next year.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the science museum. Before we start, a quick question. Has anyone here ever been inside a planetarium? Hands up. Okay, three of you. So most of you have never seen one, and today is going to be unforgettable. So far, you have only seen the entrance. In the next two hours you will see the dome, the moon rocks, and the earthquake room. Some people find the earthquake room a little scary, so if you do not want to go in, you do not have to. And one rule: please do not touch the moon rocks. They have been to space. You have not.
Have you ever been on a big roller coaster?
Yes, I have. I went last summer.
